sentences.text: The Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) is a crop insurance scheme launched by the Government of India.
It was introduced in 2016 to provide financial support to farmers in the event of crop failure due to natural calamities.
The main objective is to stabilize the income of farmers and encourage them to adopt innovative farming practices.
The scheme offers insurance coverage for crops against various risks such as droughts floods and pests.
Farmers receive compensation based on the loss of crop yield.
The benefits include a low premium rate for farmers with the government subsidizing the remaining amount.
Eligibility is open to all farmers who grow food crops oilseeds and annual commercial crops.
Farmers must be registered under the scheme to avail of the benefits.
The application process involves filling out a form and submitting it to the local revenue office or through online portals.
The timeline for the application is generally set before the sowing season of each crop.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare along with various state governments.
Insurance companies are also involved in the implementation of the scheme.
The scheme is reviewed periodically to enhance its effectiveness and reach.
